edits.old: Single-bank fan-speed derivatives use native quadratic vent/leakage losses and fan affinity, include all branch capacity and smooth-card convection changes, and differentiate the absolute speed ratio, not its logarithm.
edits.new: Independent single/series/parallel fan-bank speed derivatives use native quadratic vent/leakage losses, each member's hydraulic response and fan affinity, include all branch capacity and smooth-card convection changes, and differentiate each absolute speed ratio, not its logarithm or a common system speed.

edits.old: Independent multi-bank speeds, card regime boundaries, natural convection combined with airflow and Dirichlet-temperature derivatives are not supplied.
edits.new: Nonsmooth fan-curve knots, nonunique parallel fan inverses, card regime boundaries, natural convection combined with airflow and Dirichlet-temperature derivatives are not supplied.
